review_candidates.title: Technical Specialist
review_candidates.location: Ho Chi Minh City Metropolitan Area
review_candidates.description: Freelance LMS Integration & Technical Support Specialist Location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Engagement: Freelance / Project-based Company: T-ime Education Vietnam Role Summary T-ime Education Vietnam is looking for a freelance LMS Integration & Technical Support Specialist to support the implementation and ongoing technical integration of Renaissance Learning solutions with schools in Vietnam. The role will act as a technical bridge between Renaissance Learning's technical teams in the United States, T-ime Education Vietnam, and IT teams at Vietnamese schools. The successful candidate will support schools with LMS integration, including Canvas LTI connections, initial technical configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and communication of technical requirements between all parties. Responsibilities Support the technical implementation of Renaissance Learning solutions within Vietnamese schools. Coordinate with Renaissance Learning's technical and support teams in the United States regarding integration requirements, configuration, and troubleshooting. Work directly with school IT administrators to understand their existing LMS, network, user management, and system environment. Support the setup, configuration, testing, and validation of Canvas LTI connections and other LMS integrations. Assist schools with technical requirements relating to user access, authentication, SSO, rostering, permissions, and system configuration where applicable. Translate technical requirements between Renaissance, T-ime Education, and school IT teams into clear and practical implementation steps. Identify and troubleshoot integration issues during implementation and escalate issues to Renaissance technical teams when necessary. Support testing before system launch and help ensure that integrations function correctly for administrators, teachers, and students. Provide first-line local technical support following implementation. Maintain clear technical documentation covering configuration, implementation steps, known issues, and resolutions. Where required, participate in online meetings with Renaissance technical teams and on-site meetings with schools in Ho Chi Minh City. Qualifications and Experience Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in LMS administration, systems integration, educational technology, IT support, or a related technical role. Practical experience working with Learning Management Systems, preferably Canvas. Previous experience implementing, configuring, or supporting LMS integrations or third-party SaaS platforms. Experience with LTI-based integrations is strongly preferred. Knowledge of LTI 1.3 / LTI Advantage would be highly desirable. Experience with SSO, user authentication, APIs, user provisioning, rostering, or system integrations would be an advantage. Experience working directly with school, university, or education-sector IT teams is preferred. Previous experience supporting international software vendors, SaaS providers, or EdTech platforms would be an advantage. Demonstrated experience in technical troubleshooting and resolving system integration issues. Ability to communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English and Vietnamese, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly between international and Vietnamese teams. What Success Looks Like The successful freelancer will enable Vietnamese schools to implement Renaissance solutions efficiently by ensuring that technical requirements are clearly understood, LMS connections are configured correctly, issues are resolved quickly, and communication between the school and Renaissance's international technical teams remains effective throughout the implementation process. The role is expected to begin on a project basis, with the possibility of supporting additional school implementations and ongoing technical support as T-ime Education expands its Renaissance Learning business in Vietnam.

We offer a collaborative, performance-driven environment where people and innovation are central to our success. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist with strong expertise in candidate sourcing and talent engagement. Based in Qatar, this role will focus on identifying, attracting, and assessing qualified professionals across Arabic-speaking markets. review_candidates.title: Staff Engineer (Tech Lead), Full-Stack
review_candidates.description: Who We Are 4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut®, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions. Your Role Much of this hasn’t been designed yet — and that’s the point. We’re connecting Exonaut® to a fast-growing landscape of systems — a data lakehouse, customer ERP platforms, optimisation engines and partner platforms — on one of the most significant training transformation programmes in UK defence, and many of the hard problems are still open. We want a Staff Engineer to act as technical lead for the team: a full-stack engineer whose centre of gravity is backend and integration work, who is energised by that ambiguity and can take a vaguely-defined need, shape it with the team, and build it across the stack. You’ll lead through influence rather than formal authority, partnering closely with our Engineering Managers and Product Managers. You’ll own and evolve parts of the Exonaut® platform itself, not just wire systems together — product engineering at the seams of several moving parts, from the services and APIs underneath to the interfaces people use. There’s a clear programme direction and a strong team around you; within that, scope will shift and you’ll have the autonomy to make the calls that matter. This is a Staff role with real ownership. You’ll lead substantial pieces of work end-to-end — designing, choosing the right patterns, and seeing them through to production — and steward the technical direction across the team: the architecture, the standards, the tools, and how we test and observe what we build. You’ll still spend meaningful time hands-on in the code, with the balance gradually tilting toward leadership — your impact growing through the design sessions you lead, the engineers you mentor, and the architecture you shape across data, integrations and APIs. Day to day you’ll collaborate with other engineers, project managers and designers on the programme, with senior stakeholders on the customer side, and with peers across the wider 4C engineering organisation — where the IC track is treated as a first-class career path alongside management. What You’ll Do Hold the technical vision for our work on the programme, in close partnership with Engineering Management, Product and Delivery — and stay close enough to the code to lead by example. Figure out and build how Exonaut talks to everything around it — a data lakehouse, customer ERP systems, optimisation engines and partner platforms — often from a rough idea rather than a finished spec, reading and writing data reliably with maintainability, observability and security designed in from the start. Build full-stack features on the Exonaut® platform — the backend services and APIs, and the user-facing interfaces on top of them — so the systems you connect are matched by interfaces people can actually use. Work across a modern stack — Java and SQL on the backend, Angular on the front-end, plus pipeline and data tooling — making real architecture calls rather than inheriting someone else’s, so judgement and pragmatism matter more than experience with any one tool. Introduce event-driven and change-data-capture (CDC) patterns where they keep data flowing in near-real-time. Lead design sessions and steward the architecture across data, integrations and APIs — driving simplicity and sustainability so the calls we make today still serve the programme years from now. Help raise our engineering standards around code quality, automated testing, CI/CD and observability — building the pipelines and test automation that let us ship changes safely and often, with quality and operability treated as first-class engineering concerns, not an afterthought. Mentor and coach engineers across the team — not just juniors — mentoring Senior Engineers toward Staff-level scope, and help grow our full-stack and integration engineering practice inside 4C. Represent engineering thoughtfully with customers, partners and 4C peers — presenting technical work externally and making sure the engineering perspective has a strong voice in cross-functional and customer settings. Work directly with stakeholders on both sides — our own project managers, designers and engineers, and the customer’s technical and non-technical people — drawing out what’s really needed, explaining technical trade-offs in plain language, and making sure what we build genuinely serves the people who use it. About You An experienced full-stack engineer who still enjoys writing code, with several years operating at Senior Engineer level or above and a track record of guiding non-trivial technical work across a team or cluster of teams. Your centre of gravity is backend and data, and you’re comfortable working up the stack into the user-facing layer — so this suits a backend-leaning full-stack engineer rather than a front-end specialist. Comfortable building backend services and APIs (REST and/or event-based), integrating with third-party systems such as ERP platforms, data stores and external engines, and building the front-end on top — with a good grasp of integration patterns, authentication and performance. Strong Java and SQL, with working familiarity with Angular (or a comparable modern front-end framework). We care more about depth and judgement than about an exact match — if you’re strong in a neighbouring backend language and willing to work in Java, we’d still like to hear from you. You treat version control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD as part of building, not a separate phase. Comfortable being a team’s technical point of reference — you lead through influence, partnership and consistently good judgement. Energised rather than unsettled by ambiguity: you can pick up a new stack quickly, you’re happy to define the problem rather than only solve a specified one, and you make sound calls when requirements are still moving. We care more about that than about any specific technology you already know. Sound judgement around system and data design — including integrating with a data warehouse / lakehouse — and good instincts for when to use streaming or event-driven approaches versus batch. Pragmatic about quality: you instrument what you build and care as much about how it runs in production as how it looks in code review. A strong communicator who can hold a technical conversation with engineers and a plain-language one with project managers, designers and senior customer stakeholders — internal and external, including in regulated environments. A mentor who lifts the people around you and spreads good practice — you can point to engineers whose growth you’ve helped shape. Fluent written and spoken English, as required for security-cleared defence work and for clear communication with UK customer stakeholders. This role requires the successful candidate to be a UK national and eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC). Candidates who already hold current UK SC clearance will be at an advantage; however, we also welcome applications from individuals who meet the eligibility requirements and are willing to undergo the SC clearance process. A genuine interest in our mission — software that helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you don’t tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway — we’d genuinely like to hear from you. What You Can Expect From 4C Strategies Warminster-based, with hybrid working — typically around three days a week on-site at our office or a customer site. Some of the work needs to be done on-site, and the exact pattern can vary with the programme’s needs, but we’re supportive of flexibility where the work allows. Easily commutable from Bath, Salisbury, Trowbridge and the surrounding area. Competitive salary, reviewed annually Pension Scheme with 5% employer contribution Private healthcare including dental Enhanced family leave (maternity, paternity and adoption) 25 days holidays (plus bank holidays) Life Assurance Cycle to work scheme Company social events Why Join 4C Strategies If you’re happiest when the path isn’t drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they’re built, with a collaborative team alongside you. You’ll work with experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind. The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want Staff-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis. The process starts with a behavioural screening interview with the hiring manager; candidates who progress go through a full interview loop that, for this Staff full-stack role, includes a hands-on programming session (our stack is Java and Angular, though you’re welcome to use a language you’re comfortable in — Java, C#, TypeScript, Python or Go), a system design and architecture discussion, and a conversation about technical leadership and mentoring. 4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Analyst, Treasury
review_candidates.description: Job description: Key Responsibilities: Manage daily treasury operations, including cash positioning, payment processing, bank reconciliations, and transaction monitoring to ensure accuracy and operational efficiency. Prepare, review, and execute domestic and international payments across multiple banking platforms, ensuring timely settlement and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Monitor cash balances, forecast short-term liquidity availability, and support liquidity planning to ensure sufficient funding availability. Review, validate, investigate and resolve payment issues, including rejected transactions, returned payments, bank charges, and payment discrepancies. Maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions to support payment operations and resolve banking-related inquiries. Oversee vendor payment processes, including payment method management, check issuance, electronic payments, and payment status inquiries. Perform reconciliations and analyze outstanding items, discrepancies, and unapplied cash transactions. Support month-end closing activities related to treasury accounts, cash reporting, and financial reconciliations. Analyze treasury data and prepare reports related to cash flow, payments, outstanding obligations, and operational performance. Collaborate closely with Accounts Payable, Accounting, Procurement, Tax, and business stakeholders to resolve payment and invoice-related issues and improve end-to-end processes. Ensure adherence to internal controls, treasury policies, banking regulations, and corporate governance requirements while maintaining a strong control environment. Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and best practices to enhance treasury efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Support treasury system enhancements, integrations, and reporting improvements across SAP, Ivalua, banking platforms, and other financial systems. Coordinate audit requests by providing supporting documentation, bank confirmations, transaction records, and compliance-related evidence in a timely manner. Participate in treasury projects and strategic initiatives related to cash management, banking structure optimization, digital transformation, and process standardization. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of treasury operations, cash management, liquidity planning, and payment processing. Solid understanding of banking products, payment networks, and domestic/international payment methods. Experience working with ERP systems, particularly SAP, and treasury or financial management platforms. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reconciliation, reporting, and financial modeling techniques. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities with exceptional attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while meeting strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage internal stakeholders and external partners. Proven experience managing banking relationships, vendor inquiries, payment investigations, and issue resolution. Strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes, financial controls, reconciliation methodologies, and audit requirements. Knowledge of treasury controls, compliance requirements, and risk management principles. Continuous improvement mindset with experience identifying efficiencies, streamlining workflows, and supporting automation initiatives. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional and global teams. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. 3-5 years of experience in Treasury, Cash Management, Corporate Finance, or Banking Operations. Experience with SAP, TMS platforms, or major banking portals is highly desirable. Professional certifications such as CFA, CMA & CTP are an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Servicemonteur/ Mechaniker/ Schlosser (w/m/d) Industrieservice – Hydraulik
review_candidates.description: Einleitung Sie haben ein Herz für Maschinen? Dann sind Sie bei HANSA-FLEX genau richtig! Unsere Mission ist es, Maschinen mit modernster Hydraulik (wieder) zum Laufen zu bringen. Ob Schläuche, Rohre, Pumpen oder Zylinder: Unsere hohen Qualitätsansprüche und unser unermüdlicher Einsatz für den Kunden haben uns zu einem der international führenden Unternehmen für hydraulische Verbindungstechnik gemacht. Das höchste Gut unseres Familienunternehmens sind dabei unsere 5.000 Mitarbeiter*innen. Leben Sie Ihre Leidenschaft für Technik und verstärken Sie unser Team im Industrieservice für den Großraum Lüneburg und Hamburg als Servicemonteur/ Mechaniker/ Schlosser (w/m/d) Industrieservice – Hydraulik . Aufgaben Sie führen Wartungs-, Reparatur- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an Maschinen und Anlagen direkt bei unseren Kunden vor Ort durch. Sie tauschen Hydraulikschläuche aus und montieren hydraulische sowie mechanische Komponenten. Sie unterstützen bei der Fehlersuche und beheben Störungen an Maschinen und Anlagen. Sie wirken bei der Installation und Inbetriebnahme neuer Maschinen und Anlagen mit. Sie dokumentieren die durchgeführten Arbeiten und halten relevante Informationen für die weitere Auftragsbearbeitung fest. Profil Sie verfügen über eine technische Berufsausbildung, z. B. als Industriemechaniker, Anlagenmechaniker, Land- und Baumaschinenmechatroniker, Kfz-Mechatroniker oder in einem vergleichbaren Beruf. Erste Erfahrungen in Wartung, Instandhaltung oder Montage von Maschinen und Anlagen sind von Vorteil. Grundkenntnisse in Hydraulik sind wünschenswert, können aber auch im Rahmen der Einarbeitung erweitert werden. Sie arbeiten selbstständig, zuverlässig und haben Freude am Umgang mit Kunden. Für Einsätze im Außendienst besitzen Sie einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Sie sind bereit, sich in neue technische Themen einzuarbeiten und unterschiedliche Einsatzorte kennenzulernen. Wir bieten Finanzielle Absicherung durch eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung. Persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und eine intensive Einarbeitung in Kooperation mit der internationalen Hydraulik-Akademie. Ein Servicefahrzeug für die Flexibilität. Ihre Work-Life-Balance liegt uns am Herzen - 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bei uns profitieren Sie von unseren exklusiven Rabatten über unsere Corporate Benefits. Profitieren Sie beim Dienstrad-Leasing von attraktiven Leasingkonditionen für Ihr Wunschfahrrad. Ein Langzeitarbeitskonto für mehr Flexibilität und ein Firmenfitnessprogramm für Ihre Gesundheit. Ein familienfreundliches Unternehmen, das Eltern gerne die Kinderbetreuung bezuschusst. Unser Betriebsklima: Die Wertschätzung unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ist uns ebenso wichtig wie ein kollegialer und persönlicher Umgang, den wir z. B. durch gemeinsame Aktivitäten fördern. Für Ihre Tätigkeit im Außendienst erhalten Sie eine zusätzliche Zulage. Zudem profitieren Sie von einer Tätigkeit ohne Bereitschaftsdienst und ohne Schichtarbeit. Weitere Informationen Das klingt nach der perfekten Stelle für Sie? Dann ergreifen Sie Ihre Chance und machen Sie unsere Kunden und ihre Maschinen glücklich! Senden Sie uns Ihre Unterlagen (ohne Anschreiben) bitte über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular. review_candidates.title: ServiceNow Delivery Manager
review_candidates.description: We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Delivery Manager to take ownership of complex ServiceNow engagements and ensure successful delivery across customers, delivery teams and strategic partners. This is a senior delivery leadership role with responsibility for overseeing engagements from mobilisation through to completion. You will combine strong professional services and delivery management experience with a solid understanding of the ServiceNow platform, customer delivery and commercial management. The role will suit an experienced ServiceNow delivery professional who is comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels, managing complex stakeholder environments and ensuring delivery remains aligned to customer, contractual and commercial objectives. The Role As ServiceNow Delivery Manager , you will have end-to-end responsibility for the delivery health of a portfolio of ServiceNow engagements. You will provide leadership across delivery teams and customer stakeholders, establish effective governance, manage risks and dependencies, oversee commercial performance and ensure issues are identified and resolved proactively. Tout en axant son travail sur les enfants qui ne bénéficient pas de l’éducation parentale ou encore les enfants en difficulté dans diverses circonstances, l’organisation a développé plusieurs programmes notamment : les villages d’enfants, les centres pour jeunes, les programmes d’appui à la famille, des écoles et crèches, des centres d’apprentissage et des centres de santé mère-enfant dans chaque pays où elle déploie ses activités. SOS Villages d’Enfants est implantée en République de Guinée depuis 1989 (zones d’intervention : Conakry, Kankan, N’Zérékoré, Labé), et dépend administrativement du Bureau International Région Afrique de l’Ouest et du Centre basé à Dakar. Dans le cadre de sa planification stratégique, SOS Villages d’Enfants Guinée lance le recrutement de trois Directeurs/trices de Programme pour les sites de Conakry, N’zérékoré et Kankan. Il/elle représente l’organisation auprès des parties prenantes gouvernementales et non-gouvernementales au niveau des sites. Le DPVE est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la gestion du cycle de programme dans le site assurant ainsi que le PVE est adapté à la situation locale et contribue à l’élaboration d’un système social durable pour le groupe cible. review_candidates.title: Research Manager/Economist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Credit Bureau (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. (CBC) is the leading provider of credit information, analytical tools, and credit reporting services for organizations and consumers in Cambodia. CBC supports customers in managing the risk and reward of commercial and financial decisions through a comprehensive suite of credit reporting and analytical solutions. The company helps businesses better understand individuals, markets, and the Cambodian economy to strengthen customer relationships and improve profitability. CBC promotes financial stability by delivering accurate real-time data that enables businesses to manage credit risk, prevent fraud, and automate decision-making, while empowering individuals to monitor their credit reports and protect against identity theft. Role Description The Research Manager/Economist is a full-time, on-site role based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. This role is responsible for designing and leading research projects on credit markets, consumer behavior, and the Cambodian economy, using CBC’s data and external sources. The position involves developing research frameworks, questionnaires, and methodologies; collecting, cleaning, and analyzing quantitative and qualitative data; and producing reports, dashboards, and insights for internal stakeholders, clients, and regulators. The Research Manager/Economist will prepare policy briefs, white papers, and presentations, communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, and support product development and strategic decision-making. The role also includes coordinating with cross-functional teams, engaging with external partners, and ensuring research outputs meet high standards of accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Research abilities, including data analysis, interpretation, and synthesis of complex information. Candidates should possess Market Research experience, including applying research methodologies, conducting surveys, and analyzing market and industry trends. Candidates should possess Questionnaire Design skills, including structuring surveys, defining variables, and ensuring data quality and validity. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including report writing, presentation, and the ability to explain technical findings clearly to diverse audiences. Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Finance, Data Science, or a related field. Beneficial skills include proficiency in statistical and data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, R, Stata, SPSS, or similar), experience with database querying, and familiarity with credit risk or financial services. Additional beneficial qualifications include experience leading research projects, working with large datasets, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and strong attention to detail and data integrity. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Khmer and knowledge of the Cambodian financial sector are strong advantages.
